subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and a couple of follow-ups so we can prepare an apples-to-apples pricing estimate: 

Summary of what I heard: 
- Expected monthly token volume: ~200M tokens / month (ballpark — 100M prompts, 100M completions)
- Seasonal peak: short spikes to ~350M in Black Friday window (we discussed burst capacity)
- Target latency: ~200ms p50 for standard generation routes
- Data controls: VPC + audit logs required

A few things we need to confirm to put together a target $/1M tokens comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and host-based options: 
1) Confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens (low / target / peak).
2) Target unit price range you're evaluating (example: $10–$20 / 1M tokens).
3) Procurement cadence: are you looking for month-to-month hosted, or a committed annual reservation?

From our side I can run a short benchmark and produce a 1M-token unit economics comparison (OpenAI / Anthropic / other hosts) plus a committed pricing proposal for Redwood given the volumes. If you can confirm the three items above, I'll send a detailed pricing estimate and a short matrix that shows how costs change with commit level and quantization options.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm volume range and target $/1M tokens by EOD Mon Nov 2
- I send a pricing estimate and benchmarking CSV by Nov 3
- If the estimate looks ok, schedule a call w/ your procurement on Nov 5 to align on contract/PO timing

Thanks — 
Vanessa Ortiz

From: Alice Chen <alice@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Miller <bob@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Vanessa — thanks for the recap. Confirming details below: 

1) Volume (expected steady state): 150M–250M tokens / month. For budgeting assume 200M.
2) Target unit price we have been benchmarking toward: ideally $12–$15 / 1M tokens but pragmatic range is $12–$18 depending on commitment and SLAs.
3) Procurement: preference is for a 12-month committed arrangement with quarterly usage reconciliation. Procurement will prefer a committed monthly minimum and the ability to bank unused tokens for a short window.

On benchmarking: our internal procurement notes show public hosted list prices in the ballpark of: OpenAI-like managed endpoints ~$20 / 1M for the family we tested, Anthropic ~$22 / 1M. We are also evaluating host-providers (self-hosted on hosted GPUs) where we see unit economics ranging $10–$14 / 1M depending on quantization and sustained throughput, but those options add ops complexity and longer lead time.

Two asks for your estimate: 
- Can Redwood give committed pricing down to $12 / 1M with a 12-month, 200M/mo commit?
- Please include a simple tiered pricing table so we can see breakpoints at 100M, 200M, 400M/mo.

Happy to review the estimate when you send.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of AI Platform, Acme Retail
alice@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Vanessa — quick internal note (cc'ing you). Based on Acme's ask and comparable deals: 
- For a 12-month 200M/mo commit we can consider a $13–$14 / 1M introductory price with a 6-month ramp and a 12-month minimum. That keeps unit economics intact vs our current host costs and preserves margin.
- Recommend offering tiered pricing: 100M: $16 / 1M; 200M: $14 / 1M; 400M+: $12 / 1M. Include a clause for short-term burst overage at a slightly higher rate.
- Ask legal to confirm standard commitment language (banking unused tokens for one quarter).

I'll prepare the pricing estimate PDF and attach a benchmarking CSV comparing OpenAI/Anthropic/self-hosted assumptions.

Marissa
Director, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

Alice — thanks for the clarity. Attached is a short pricing estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf) and the benchmarking CSV (acme-token-benchmarking.csv) that show assumptions and the OpenAI/Anthropic comparisons you asked for. High-level proposal: 

- 12-month commitment, 200M tokens/mo committed (banking up to 1 quarter)
- Tiered unit pricing: 100M = $16 / 1M, 200M = $14 / 1M, 400M+ = $12 / 1M
- Short-term burst handled with auto-burst at committed throughput + 50% at $18 / 1M for overage beyond committed banked tokens

If that aligns, next steps: 
1) Please confirm acceptance of the 200M / 12-month structure (or provide counter target $/1M).
2) We schedule a procurement + finance alignment call — I have availability Thu Nov 5 at 10:00am PT.
3) If accepted, I'll loop in Legal for a short SOW and send a finalized quote for PO.

Thanks again — attaching files in this thread.

Best,
